long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Dusk is nearly gone and I have too much restlessness to sit still.

steps.makes: a labnote of the moon's colour
steps.reason: The sky is still worth looking at, and the telescope is mine.
The bed is soft and it is close to night, so I will settle there.

today.reason: The sleep step was turned down because it needs night, so I will use the last of dusk for the zoomies and the telescope, then curl up on the bed until it is truly night.
